title: Minimal account creation
summary: Delay nonessential profile setup and collect only the information needed to create a usable account or satisfy the immediate transaction.
problem: Large signup forms turn future personalization needs into immediate acquisition friction.
use_when: Users can receive value before completing a rich profile
Many profile fields are optional or can be collected later
avoid_when: Identity, compliance, or transaction rules require specific information before access
rationale: Account creation should unlock value rather than become a separate data-collection project.
Progressive profile completion can happen when each field becomes relevant.

use_if: Users can receive value before completing a rich profile
Many profile fields are optional or can be collected later
prefer_alternatives_if: Required verification or compliance data must be collected before account use

requirements: Use proper labels and error recovery.
Do not block password managers or paste without a specific security reason.
Separate required account data from optional profile data.
Offer alternative sign-in methods only when they genuinely help, not as the sole path.
